page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance across stress-ng, PassMark, and Geekbench multi-core suites. Memory bandwidth and database operations, including Redis SET operations, also perform in the middle 50 percent tier, alongside average static web serving throughput and small-to-medium LLM inference speeds.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density make this instance suitable for workloads requiring sustained, multi-threaded CPU capacity without the premium of newer-generation hardware. The lack of local storage requires external block storage configuration. This instance is best suited for multi-threaded workloads such as general-purpose web serving, database operations, software compilation, and medium-scale text or image processing.
